0.reason: impl_source reads computed only when every in-scope section carries recorded hours and declarations when any hours are imputed or counted; tests/test_impl_writes_are_refused_where_derived.py pins that distinction, which tells a reader whether the figure rests on recorded effort

2.reason: the negative control restores the base reader, which skips declarations, and the declarations-with-no-records case fails under it; that is the base arm for this case

findings.text: follow-on: the plan section 2 prose states impl_source reads computed whenever any hours were used, but the imputed partial-coverage case at line 934 returns declarations; the value deviates from the written spec and the coordinator must reconcile it, since the out-of-scope tests/test_impl_writes_are_refused_where_derived.py:123 pins declarations for partial records.

follow-on: the imputed mean is taken over the hours of every record including a section declared deferred, whose record sits outside the denominator, so a deferred record's large effort can inflate the weight of an in-scope section with no recorded hours; no test drives a deferred record through the imputation.

follow-on: the declarations-with-no-records case has no base-arm comparison on disk, so the done_when's 'add no failure against base' for the reader set is inferred from a green head arm rather than measured.
